title: Held close in the hidden hour
summary: The Lord keeps the humble servant near, against His own heart. Stand where grace holds you, not where status ranks you.
takeaway: Stand where grace holds you, not where status ranks you.
lifeApplication: At the mirror, after the silence, or before the proving message, speak to the Lord as one already being held.

source.shortMeaning: The Lord keeps the humble servant near, against His own heart.
source.lifeApplication: When silence starts sounding final, repeat the line until closeness feels truer than absence.

evidence.coreClaim: The Lord keeps the humble servant near, against His own heart.
evidence.turn: Hold onto this: stay humble enough to be kept close and cherished by the Lord.
evidence.practicalImplication: At the mirror, after the silence, or before the proving message, speak to the Lord as one already being held.
